seoTitle: How to Use Nectar Points on eBay Under the New Rules
metaDescription: Learn how to link your Nectar account to eBay, collect 2 points per £1, and understand what purchases don't earn points under the current rules.
intro: Nectar points on eBay work through a dedicated linking page rather than something buried in your eBay account settings, and the exclusions matter as much as the earning rate. Once your Nectar account is connected, eBay purchases earn points automatically at checkout, but a few common line items are quietly excluded from earning anything. This guide covers linking your account through the actual Nectar-eBay page, what the current earning rate is, and exactly what doesn't count toward your balance.

steps.heading: Find the Nectar and eBay linking page
steps.body: eBay's Nectar partnership runs through a dedicated page headed "Collect 2 points per £1 at eBay," branded with both the Nectar logo and the eBay logo side by side. This is where the two accounts get connected, and it's worth bookmarking since it's the fastest way back if you ever need to check your link status or re-authenticate. The page also carries a short explainer of what eBay is for anyone new to the marketplace, plus a Terms & Conditions and Privacy Information link worth reading once before you rely on it.

image.caption: The Nectar-eBay page confirming the current earn rate of 2 points per £1, with a note on which purchases don't qualify.

steps.heading: Sign in or join to link your account
steps.body: On the linking page, existing Nectar members select Sign in and log in with their Nectar credentials, while new members use Join now to create an account first. Either path leads to the same place: an authenticated connection between your Nectar card and your eBay account, after which points accrue automatically on qualifying purchases without any extra steps at checkout.

steps.heading: Know what doesn't earn points
steps.body: The page states plainly that Nectar points "will not be awarded on VAT, cost of delivery, gift cards, or other promotions." That means your points accrue only on the actual item price, not the total you pay at checkout — a £50 item with £5 delivery and VAT included earns points on a smaller base than your final charge suggests. Gift card purchases specifically don't earn points at all, so buying an eBay gift card as a way to rack up Nectar points doesn't work under these rules.

steps.heading: Check your balance before you buy
steps.body: Once linked, your Nectar balance is visible from your Nectar account (via the Home link on the same site) rather than from inside eBay itself. Checking it before a big purchase tells you whether you have enough points to make redemption worthwhile, since applying a small number of points to a large order barely moves the price.

steps.heading: Apply points at checkout
steps.body: On an eligible order, eBay's checkout surfaces the option to redeem available Nectar points, letting you apply them partially or in full depending on your balance and the order total. Because points don't accrue on delivery, VAT, or gift cards, it's worth double-checking the redemption screen shows the discount you expect before completing the purchase, rather than assuming the full order value is being credited.

steps.heading: Watch expiry dates and combine offers carefully
steps.body: Nectar points expire if left unused for too long, so it's worth checking your balance periodically rather than letting it sit untouched for months. Whether points stack with an active eBay coupon or sale price can vary by promotion, so treat any specific combination as unconfirmed until the checkout page actually shows both discounts applied together.

faq.question: How do I link my Nectar account to eBay?
faq.answer: Go to the dedicated Nectar-eBay page and either sign in with your existing Nectar account or select Join now to create one, then complete the authentication to link it to your eBay account.

faq.question: What's the current Nectar points earning rate on eBay?
faq.answer: The linking page states 2 points per £1 spent, though this excludes VAT, delivery cost, gift cards, and other promotions.

faq.question: Do gift card purchases earn Nectar points on eBay?
faq.answer: No. The Nectar-eBay terms specifically exclude gift cards from earning points, along with VAT, delivery costs, and certain promotions.

faq.question: Can I combine Nectar points with eBay coupons?
faq.answer: It depends on the specific promotion. Check the redemption screen at checkout to confirm whether both a coupon and Nectar points are actually being applied together before completing the order.

faq.question: Do Nectar points expire?
faq.answer: Yes, Nectar points can expire if left unused, so it's worth checking your balance from your Nectar account periodically to avoid losing value.
